primary_sources.exact_anchor: Section 5, printed p. 42 / PDF p. 44, defines the continuous Newton flow z-dot=-f/f' and states that f maps its trajectories to straight radial lines from the origin; critical values control singular behavior.

primary_sources.title: Geometry of Polynomials and Root-Finding via Path-Lifting
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Abstract and algorithmic setup: roots are found by lifting a decreasing value path; complexity is governed by inverse-branch radii and angles to critical values. The paper explicitly combines covering structure, distortion, and critical-value geometry.
primary_sources.supports: Modern primary-source context for polynomial inverse-branch path lifting and the metric relevance of critical values.
primary_sources.does_not_support: No theorem that a hub selected by an external pair-distance argument has two Newton branches of total arclength below two.

primary_sources.does_not_support: No arclength estimate or polynomial-specific critical-hub selection.

mechanism_comparison.standard_core: Away from critical values, a radial value path lifts uniquely to inverse branches, equivalently to finite-time trajectories of the continuous Newton flow. This gives containment in the corresponding strict sublevel set.
mechanism_comparison.invalid_transfer: A different theorem selects a critical hub because two roots are metrically close to it. Replacing the straight spokes by the same hub's canonical descending Newton branches preserves containment but does not preserve the sum of Euclidean spoke lengths.
mechanism_comparison.local_delta: The exact rational quintic certifies the two relevant branches through a regular half-level and uses Rouché disks plus triangle inequalities to prove their combined length exceeds 2.083996.
mechanism_comparison.terminology_boundary: 'Same-hub Newton replacement' is useful internal route language, but the public mathematical noun should identify the proved failure: a fixed-hub Newton-branch length counterexample. 'Metric-selected' describes how the hub entered the proof architecture, not an intrinsic property of Newton flow.
mechanism_comparison.surviving_routes: The certificate does not minimize over critical hubs and does not rule out another path inside the lemniscate. It leaves least-critical-value selection, global hub comparison, component/Reeb-tree geometry, and non-Newton connectors open.
